intended_object: The canonical closed immersion of affine group schemes over ℤ from the closed subgroup scheme of GLₙ generated by the weight torus and the Kostant root subgroups indexed by S, into the full toral closure (generated by the torus and all root subgroups). Inferred from the docstring, the module documentation and the closed-immersion instance that follows it.
explanation:
Both group schemes are built as Spec of quotients of the coordinate Hopf algebra of GLₙ over ℤ. The subsystem carrier is Spec(A/J_S), where J_S is the common-kernel Hopf ideal of the root-subgroup maps indexed by S together with the torus map. The toral closure is Spec(A/J), where J is the common-kernel Hopf ideal of all of these maps. The lemma `kostantToralDefiningIdeal_le_kostantTorusSubsystemDefiningIdeal` gives J ≤ J_S. `quotientSpecMapOfLe` turns this into the map Spec(A/J_S) → Spec(A/J), which goes in the right direction: from the smaller subgroup to the larger one. This is the standard inclusion of one closed subgroup scheme into another containing it. The file also proves that the map is a closed immersion and that it commutes with the inclusions into GLₙ.

Working over ℤ is not too narrow: the construction rests on the Kostant ℤ-form of the universal enveloping algebra, so ℤ is its natural base. Mathlib has no counterpart for this specific morphism.
